verdict.rationale: Heap documents an official web install snippet that loads its JavaScript library, with client-side API methods for track, identify, reset identity, event properties, and addUserProperties. The docs also claim cross-platform installs across many frameworks, which together amount to a first-party client SDK. Server-side integration, however, is shown only as raw REST endpoints (track, bulk track, identify, account properties, user deletion), with no named language or mobile SDKs and no OpenAPI spec for generating clients. missing for 10: explicitly named official SDKs per language/platform (mobile, server-side libraries), SDK reference docs or versioning, an OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
